purpose: Says what a host must have before this controller can be built or run, so that a gate refusal can be attributed. Round 20 ran check-digest-pins on a host without gh and got an unexplained digest -- correct fail-closed behaviour, indistinguishable from a controller defect, and since build-linux-manifest.mjs runs that gate first, the manifest could not be rebuilt there at all. Requested since round 15 as R15-N1 and not written until now.
how_to_read_this: The four binaries below are pinned inside the controller and their digests must match exactly -- a different build of the same version will not do, because the manifest and the runtime checks name bytes, not versions. The shell tools are pinned by this document and checked before use. RuntimeDependencyManifest.json separately pins the complete Ajv and recursive dependency package trees; a mutable named volume is never treated as a byte identity.
attribution_rule: If check-digest-pins.mjs refuses AND prints HOST INCOMPLETE, the host is missing a binary: install it and run again. If it refuses without that line, the refusal is about the controller.

runtime_boundary.precondition: The relay first inspects the exact container ID and refuses unless State.Running is true and Image is the exact image_id. The same fixed interactive TTY session carries every later protocol frame; no caller selects a container, image, shell, repository path, or command.
runtime_boundary.repository_mount: /home/user/cross-memory-system is the fixed read-only host repository mount
runtime_boundary.runtime_dependencies: apps/clued-cloud is a fixed named volume boundary, but volume identity is not trusted as byte identity; RuntimeDependencyManifest.json re-hashes the complete Ajv package trees before require('ajv').

required_binaries.role: runs the controller; the trusted entry checks its bytes before exec
validates the source manifest before node starts, and runs bridge.py/fixed_host.py/parent600.py
the 600-second run is a docker container; parent600 invokes this binary by absolute path
trusted-github.mjs re-hashes it before every API call

not_pinned_and_why.what: the Windows PowerShell process, Docker Desktop engine, and fixed-path Docker CLI that establish the relay
not_pinned_and_why.reason: They are the host-side execution boundary. The controller fixes their location and the exact running container/image identity, while Owner review fixes the relay source. Linux /usr/bin/dash is selected explicitly from the inspected immutable toolhost image.

not_pinned_and_why.what: the docker daemon and its storage driver
not_pinned_and_why.reason: the controller pins the client binary and validates the image by digest; the daemon is outside what a byte pin can cover.

container_image.note: Obtained via mirror.gcr.io: the docker.io blob CDN is blocked by this environment's proxy policy. The digest is identical from either source and the controller's own image_valid() checks it.
